no-reader:queue.title: Nobody reads Audit
no-reader:queue.message: Orders sends to Audit, but nothing consumes it: messages pile up.
no-reader:queue.rationale: A queue with producers and no consumers only grows. Every queue should have a consumer that takes its messages.

fix.label: Add a consumer…
fix.choice: Pick what reads Audit, then add it and connect queue to it.

capacity:orders.title: Orders can't keep up
capacity:orders.message: At the diagram's own rates, it gets 6/s and handles 1/s (600%): its backlog only grows.
capacity:orders.rationale: Demand above what a service can handle never drains: latency and backlog grow until something times out. Live view's Show capacity has the same numbers.

fix.label: Set replicas to 11 and Order events partitions to 11 and Returns partitions to 11
